claims.claim: Medical evidence from a GP or specialist is helpful for an Attendance Allowance claim.
claims.quote: It's best if you can get a healthcare professional you've seen recently to fill in this section - for example a doctor, consultant or Macmillan nurse.
claims.note: The text recommends a statement from a doctor or consultant on the form and asks for GP details, but does not describe separate medical evidence from a GP or specialist as helpful for ordinary claims.

claims.claim: Details of a carer are needed for the claim if you have one.
claims.note: The list of what you need to apply does not include carer details; the text only says you do not need a carer to claim.
